speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing frequent nosebleeds, bleeding from your mucous membranes, and a rash of tiny red spots called petechiae. To determine the cause of these symptoms, have you been feeling unusually tired, short of breath, or have you noticed any bruising without injury?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP). The clinical presentation of frequent epistaxis, gum bleeding, and petechiae in a 4-year-old male, combined with unexplained bruising, is classic for ITP. REQUEST IMAGES: Full body photograph of petechiae and bruising distribution.
